items.name: prescription: atorvastatin
items.note: Prescribed medicines and drugs are includible.

items.name: bladder control pads, moderate, 54 count
items.note: Diapers are excluded unless needed to relieve the effects of a particular disease; adult incontinence products qualify when used for a medical condition.

items.name: unidentified health and beauty item
items.note: The line names only a department (health and beauty), which mixes eligible medicine with ineligible personal care; the item can't be classified.

items.name: lidocaine burn relief gel, 4 oz
items.note: Burn dressings and medicated burn gels are medical supplies and OTC medicines.

items.name: fingertip pulse oximeter
items.note: A pulse oximeter is a device used in diagnosing and monitoring illness.

items.name: paper medical tape, 1 in
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: mint mouthwash, 1 liter
items.note: Pub 502 names toothbrush and toothpaste as nondeductible personal expenses.

items.name: prescription: albuterol inhaler
items.note: Prescribed medicines and drugs are includible.

items.name: captioned telephone
items.note: Special telephone equipment that lets a person who is deaf, hard of hearing or speech disabled communicate is includible; an amplified phone sold to anyone needs documentation of that use.

items.name: stainless steel grab bar, 24 in
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: nicotine gum 4 mg, 100 count
items.note: Pub 502 excludes non-prescribed stop-smoking drugs from the deduction, but for HSA/FSA reimbursement they are OTC medicines, eligible after 2019.
